policy: Official Toyota U.S. retail, full-spec, brochure, BuyAToyota and Toyota USA Newsroom sources only. Missing/non-applicable values are explicitly labelled and never guessed. Gallery assets use Toyota retail AEM imagery and must pass repository gallery-health checks before production readiness.

bZ.powertrain: Battery-electric crossover; FWD uses one electric motor and AWD uses front and rear electric motors with X-MODE
bZ.horsepower: Up to 221 hp FWD / 338 total-system hp AWD
bZ.efficiency: EPA-estimated driving range varies by battery and drivetrain; up to 314 miles on XLE FWD Plus
bZ.dimensions: 184.6 in L × 73.2 in W × 65.0 in H; 112.2 in wheelbase
bZ.cargo: 27.7 cu ft behind the rear seats; up to 56.9 cu ft with the second row folded
bZ.technology: 14-in Toyota Audio Multimedia touchscreen, NACS charging port, available dual wireless charging and DC fast charging from 10% to 80% in about 30 minutes under ideal conditions
bZ.warranty: 36 months/36,000 miles basic; 60 months/60,000 miles powertrain; EV driving components including traction battery 8 years/100,000 miles
bZ.gallery_asset_note: Toyota states the 2027 bZ carries over unchanged from 2026; official Toyota 2026 retail carryover imagery is used.

GR Corolla.torque: 295 lb-ft on standard GR Corolla; 302 lb-ft on GRMN
GR Corolla.transmission: 8-speed GAZOO Racing Direct Automatic Transmission (DAT) or 6-speed intelligent Manual Transmission (iMT)
GR Corolla.efficiency: Up to 21/28 MPG city/highway with manual transmission; automatic configurations are rated lower
GR Corolla.dimensions: 173.6 in L × 72.8 in W × about 57.2 in H; 103.9 in wheelbase
GR Corolla.technology: 8-in Toyota Audio Multimedia touchscreen, 12.3-in digital gauge cluster and wireless Apple CarPlay/Android Auto compatibility
GR Corolla.warranty: 36 months/36,000 miles basic; 60 months/60,000 miles powertrain; ToyotaCare scheduled maintenance for 2 years/25,000 miles

GR Supra.transmission: 6-speed intelligent Manual Transmission or 8-speed automatic transmission
GR Supra.efficiency: Current U.S. retail ratings: up to 22/29 MPG city/highway automatic and 19/26 MPG manual
GR Supra.dimensions: 172.5 in L × 73.0 in W × 51.1 in H; 97.2 in wheelbase
GR Supra.technology: 8.8-in multimedia display with available premium audio/navigation and connected convenience features
GR Supra.safety: Forward-collision warning with automatic emergency braking, lane-departure warning with steering assist and available driver-assistance package features
GR Supra.warranty: 36 months/36,000 miles basic; 60 months/60,000 miles powertrain; ToyotaCare scheduled maintenance for 2 years/25,000 miles

GR86.efficiency: Up to 20/26 MPG city/highway on Toyota's 2027 retail listing
GR86.dimensions: 167.9 in L × 69.9 in W × about 51.6 in H; 101.4 in wheelbase
GR86.cargo: Approximately 6.3 cu ft trunk capacity on the current U.S. body
GR86.technology: 8-in touchscreen multimedia system, 7-in GR digital gauge cluster and smartphone integration
GR86.safety: Active safety suite includes pre-collision braking, lane-departure/sway warning, automatic high beams and adaptive cruise control; equipment varies with transmission/grade
GR86.warranty: 36 months/36,000 miles basic; 60 months/60,000 miles powertrain; ToyotaCare scheduled maintenance for 2 years/25,000 miles

Mirai.powertrain: Toyota Fuel Cell System hydrogen fuel-cell electric powertrain with rear-wheel drive
Mirai.efficiency: EPA-estimated 76 city / 71 highway MPGe on the current U.S. Mirai
Mirai.dimensions: 195.8 in L × 74.2 in W × 57.9 in H; 114.9 in wheelbase
Mirai.technology: 12.3-in Toyota Audio Multimedia touchscreen with premium connectivity and available advanced parking/driver convenience technology
Mirai.warranty: 36 months/36,000 miles basic; 60 months/60,000 miles powertrain; key FCEV components covered for 8 years/100,000 miles

Sequoia.transmission: 10-speed electronically controlled automatic transmission with intelligence
Sequoia.efficiency: Up to an EPA-estimated 22 combined MPG
Sequoia.dimensions: 208.1 in L × 79.8 in W × about 75.4 in H; 122.0 in wheelbase on the referenced U.S. configuration
Sequoia.cargo: 22.3 cu ft behind the third row; up to 86.9 cu ft with rear seating folded/stowed as applicable
Sequoia.technology: 14-in Toyota Audio Multimedia touchscreen with wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility and available towing/camera assistance features
Sequoia.warranty: 36 months/36,000 miles basic; 60 months/60,000 miles powertrain; hybrid components 8 years/100,000 miles and hybrid battery 10 years/150,000 miles

Toyota Crown.powertrain: Fifth-generation Toyota Hybrid System on XLE, Limited and Nightshade; 2.4L turbo Hybrid MAX on Platinum; standard AWD
Toyota Crown.horsepower: 236 combined hp on XLE/Limited/Nightshade; 340 combined hp on Platinum Hybrid MAX
Toyota Crown.torque: Platinum Hybrid MAX: 400 lb-ft combined; Toyota does not publish one family-wide combined-system torque figure for the THS 5 grades
Toyota Crown.transmission: Electronically controlled continuously variable transmission on THS 5 grades; Direct Shift-6AT on Platinum Hybrid MAX
Toyota Crown.efficiency: EPA-estimated 40 combined MPG on XLE, Limited and Nightshade; Platinum Hybrid MAX prioritizes higher performance
Toyota Crown.dimensions: 196.1 in L × 72.4 in W × 60.6 in H; 112.2 in wheelbase
Toyota Crown.technology: 12.3-in Toyota Audio Multimedia touchscreen and digital gauge cluster; wireless Apple CarPlay/Android Auto; higher grades add Panoramic View Monitor, Traffic Jam Assist and Digital Key capability
Toyota Crown.warranty: 36 months/36,000 miles basic; 60 months/60,000 miles powertrain; hybrid components 8 years/100,000 miles and hybrid battery 10 years/150,000 miles

Toyota Crown Signia.engine: 2.5L 4-cylinder Toyota Hybrid System with Electronic On-Demand AWD
Toyota Crown Signia.dimensions: 194.1 in L × 74.0 in W × about 64.0 in H; 112.2 in wheelbase
Toyota Crown Signia.cargo: 25.8 cu ft behind the rear seat; up to 68.8 cu ft with the second row laid flat
Toyota Crown Signia.technology: 12.3-in Toyota Audio Multimedia touchscreen and 12.3-in digital gauge cluster; available Panoramic View Monitor, Digital Rearview Mirror and Traffic Jam Assist
Toyota Crown Signia.warranty: 36 months/36,000 miles basic; 60 months/60,000 miles powertrain; hybrid components 8 years/100,000 miles and hybrid battery 10 years/150,000 miles
